class Modulo {

    private final long mod;

    public Modulo(long mod) {
        this.mod = mod;
    }

    public long add(long a, long b) {
        long c = a + b;
        return c >= mod ? c - mod : c;
    }

    public long sub(long a, long b) {
        long c = a - b;
        return c < 0 ? c + mod : c;
    }

    public long mult(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    public long div(long a, long b) {
        return mult(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }

    public long pow(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1L;
        a %= mod;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1L) > 0) res = (res * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public long comb(int n, int k, long[] facts) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0L;
        return mult(facts[n], mult(pow(facts[k], mod - 2), pow(facts[n - k], mod - 2)));
    }

    public long[] factorials(int n) {
        long[] f = new long[n + 1];
        f[0] = 1L;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        return f;
    }
